1,500 Drones, One Island: Your BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Sentosa Plan for December
 The DANAMIC Team November 16, 2026 6 minutes read

 Sentosa Development Corporation (SDC) and Resorts World Sentosa (RWS) are turning Sentosa into what they call the single largest stop of BTS THE CITY ARIRANG SINGAPORE . It runs from 4 to 31 December on the island and until 3 January 2027 at RWS. For ARMY (the name BTS fans go by) who want in without a concert ticket, the big draw is a 1,500-drone light show over Palawan Beach from 18 to 20 December, and the cheapest paid entry anywhere on the programme is S$10 .
 The celebration takes its name from ARIRANG , the fifth studio album BTS released in March 2026. Sentosa’s share of it spreads across two beaches, a convention centre, a theme park, and three hotels, so the smartest approach is to pick a few anchor nights and build the trip around them.
 Santa-hatted pixel BTS floats off Sentosa at sunset, your cue to plan for 4 to 31 December! Drone Weekend: 18 to 20 December
 The BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Rave & Drone Party at Sentosa takes over Palawan Beach on 18, 19 and 20 December , which is a Friday to Sunday. That makes it the easiest event on the programme to plan a getaway around! As night falls, 1,500 drones fill the sky above the beach to BTS music in a show presented in partnership with Visa. Local K-pop deejay DJ RAW , who has played Waterbomb Singapore, handles the music as the party runs into the night.
 By day, Palawan Beach runs as the fan social hub, with parasols, a DJ spinning top hits, and the pixel-art Giant Inflatable sitting off the coast. Come early, stay late, and you’ve got a full day out of one beach.
 A 3km Warm-Up on 12 December
 The BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Run at Sentosa on Saturday, 12 December sends 5,000 runners along a 3km route at Palawan Green , with fan-favourite hits playing along the way. Entry costs S$50 early bird or S$77 standard . The race pack includes T-shirts, bags, and swimming floats.
 At 3km, this is a run built for finish-line photos rather than personal bests. Runners can head straight to the BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Photo Points at Palawan Green afterwards, then close the night at the Rave with DJ RAW.
 The Fan Village, From S$10
 The official BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Fan Village runs at Resorts World Convention Centre from 16 to 22 December , 11am to 10pm . General admission costs S$10 , and it comes with a S$10 gift voucher to spend inside the village, so the entry fee comes straight back to you as credit. Tickets are sold both online and on-site.
 Key art for the BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Fan Village at Resorts World Convention Centre, open 16 to 22 December Inside, there’s a welcome tunnel and a larger-than-life Music Box installation. You’ll also find PLAY, TASTE and BEAUTY zones, with photo booths, food that mixes Korean favourites with Singapore flavours, and hair tinsels and face gems for anyone who wants to look the part.
 The main activity is TEAM ON THE RUN! , a mission-based challenge where teams work through a series of interactive missions. Each player gets a team identifier and each team gets a complimentary photo. The online-only RUN! Ultimate Fan Pass at S$40 bundles admission, the S$10 voucher, and the gameplay.
 Some fans won’t need a Fan Village ticket at all. RWS lists complimentary entry for attraction ticket holders within 16 to 22 December, Season Pass holders, BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Night Out ticket holders, and hotel guests.
 Night Out at Universal Studios
 BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Night Out at Universal Studios Singapore (USS) runs on Monday, 21 December , from 8pm to 1am . The after-hours party includes access to selected rides across the park, Korean DJ DJ JAGI spinning iconic hits, a high-energy dance performance, and trivia and fan challenges with prizes up for grabs.
 Key art for BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Night Out, set for 21 December from 8pm to 1am at Universal Studios Singapore An Early Bird Single at S$58 covers USS admission, Fan Village admission, and a gift of either a reusable cup or a packable carrier. Regular tickets are S$58 for one person or S$108 for two, without the gift.
 This is the best-value ticket on the whole programme, right ? Fan Village entry is already included, which wipes out that S$10 if you’d planned to go anyway.
 Fireworks and Lightscape All Month
 Can’t make 21 December? BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Fireworks light up USS at 8pm on 4, 5, 11, 12, 16 to 20, and 22 to 25 December , plus 1 and 2 January 2027 . They’re included with regular USS admission, though RWS notes that displays depend on weather, safety, and operational conditions and may change or be cancelled without notice.
 BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Fireworks over Universal Studios Singapore, scheduled at 8pm on selected nights through 2 January 2027 The BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Lightscape runs nightly from 7.30pm , from 4 December to 3 January 2027. It projects themed visuals onto the Revenge of the Mummy façade in the Ancient Egypt zone, and it’s included with regular admission too, so a normal park day that runs past sunset gets both shows thrown in.
 Photo Points, Trains and Cable Cars
 The fan trail starts on the way in. The BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Themed Sentosa Express and the Themed cable car on the Sentosa Line run between VivoCity and Beach Station in three designs, and wrapped buses shuttle fans to RWS. Spotting all three designs is half the fun!
 On the island, five installations from Central Beach Bazaar to Palawan Green use convex-mirror walls and surfboards around four themes: Escape, Play, Unwind, and Explore. At Sensoryscape, there are BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Tape Hammocks, and Symphony Streams and Scented Sphere play music through the garden. The Stamp Rally on Weverse, BTS’s fan app, runs at Beach Station Guest Services and RWS.
 Eat It, Sleep It
 The limited-edition RWS Flavours in Harmony signature sharing box costs S$45++ . It’s served at select RWS outlets, including Horatio, Syun, Quan, and Kamon. Highlights include Mala Gochujang Beef Skewers, Golden Yuja Prawn, and Bulgogi Cod, with a Berry Muscat Crystal Mousse to finish.
 Themed giftboxes with a red tumbler, pouch, luggage tag and coin pouch, redeemable with select purchases while stocks last For overnighters, the BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Stay Experience offers curated rooms at Hotel Ora and Equarius Hotel , plus a Signature Stay Experience at The Laurus . Each package comes with a themed room keycard and take-home merchandise. RWS’s Lena Lee invites fans “to turn their pilgrimage into a complete getaway this holiday season,” and a hotel guest gets Fan Village entry thrown in.
 Themed gifts with purchase can be redeemed through qualifying spend at participating Fan Village offerings and through select passes, attraction tickets, and hotel stays. They’re limited editions available while stocks last, so don’t leave them to the final weekend.
 The Four Days to Book
 If you can only commit to one stretch, make it Friday, 18 to Monday, 21 December . Spend the days at the Fan Village and the beach, the nights at the drone party, and finish with Night Out, whose ticket covers Fan Village entry anyway. Visa cardholders had early access to selected activations on RWS’s website on 10 and 11 November, ahead of the general sale.
 🗓️ Date: 4 to 31 December 2026 on Sentosa; 4 December 2026 to 3 January 2027 at RWS
⏰ Time: Fan Village 11am to 10pm; Night Out 8pm to 1am; Lightscape nightly from 7.30pm
📍 Location: Palawan Beach, Palawan Green, Central Beach Bazaar, Sensoryscape, Resorts World Convention Centre, and Universal Studios Singapore, Sentosa
🏃 BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Run: 12 December, Palawan Green, S$50 early bird or S$77 standard
🚁 Rave & Drone Party: 18 to 20 December, Palawan Beach
🎪 Fan Village: 16 to 22 December, S$10 with a S$10 voucher, RUN! Ultimate Fan Pass S$40 online
🎢 Night Out: 21 December, from S$58 including Fan Village admission
🎆 Fireworks: Selected nights at 8pm, included with regular USS admission
🍱 Sharing Box: S$45++ at select RWS outlets
 Whether you’re an ARMY planning the whole four days or someone who wants to see 1,500 drones over a beach, this December gives you plenty to choose from for S$10 to S$58 a night. Tickets and full details for the beach events and the run are on the Sentosa BTS THE CITY ARIRANG SINGAPORE page , while the Fan Village, Night Out, and stays can be booked through Resorts World Sentosa’s event page . Lock in your drone night first, then build the rest of your Sentosa trip around it!
 Photos and Visuals courtesy of Sentosa Development Corporation and Resorts World Sentosa.
